Claim 1 (Currently amended): A computer-implemented method for trading combinations of financial instruments, said method comprising: receiving, during a selected time period, combination orders to trade financial instruments; storing each eligible received combination order, wherein a received combination order is eligible if it satisfies at least one selected condition, wherein said at least one selected condition includes the necessary condition that all financial instruments specified by the legs of an eligible order are in a set of two or more selected financial instruments; and processing eligible orders or expanded eligible orders with a combinatorial matching algorithm (CMA), wherein said processing begins at a selected time, and wherein said CMA is executed by a computer.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising a computer-readable medium having computer-executable instructions stored thereon for causing a computer to implement the steps of said method.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): A computer-based system for trading combinations of financial instruments, said system comprising: a computer for obtaining combination orders to trade financial instruments; and a computer for obtaining a matched collection of expanded eligible orders, wherein an obtained order is eligible if it satisfies at least one selected condition, and wherein said at least one selected condition includes the necessary condition that all financial instruments specified by the legs of an eligible order are in a set of two or more selected financial instruments.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The system of claim 23, further comprising a computer for increasing, at least in principle, the quality of said matched collection.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The system of claim 23, further comprising a computer for providing additional trading functionality.
